description: Reconstruction of Cell Systems 2020 Figure 2D: ProTherm single-point mutation DeltaDeltaG Spearman correlation across 3,471 mutations.
notes: Rosetta REU baseline is recomputed directly from raw local CSV with 10,000 bootstrap iterations. ProteinSolver per-mutation network scores (protherm_wresults.torch) were not bundled in git; its Spearman rho=0.444 is reconstructed from author notebook 07 Cell 72. The rho=0.551 core subset is an exploratory notebook analysis, NOT Figure 2E.
